issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Monid
products.tagline: OpenRouter for agent tools
products.summaryZh: OpenRouter 智能体工具
products.descriptionZh: 我们将您的AI代理连接到1,800多个API，无需任何订阅。SEO、潜在客户生成、视频/音乐制作、社交媒体、股票、市场趋势、链上数据、竞争对手追踪、情绪分析，一把钥匙即可全部解锁。
products.description: We connect your AI agent to 1,800+ APIs without any subscriptions. SEO, lead gen, video/music generation, social media, stocks, market trends, on-chain data, competitor tracking, sentiment analysis, all unlocked with one key.

products.name: Browzer
products.tagline: Put your technical content on autopilot
products.summaryZh: 让技术内容实现自动化管理
products.descriptionZh: 连接你的GitHub仓库，Browzer即可自动起草文档、指南、更新日志、操作手册、快速入门指南以及SEO与AEO友好的博客文章，并在每次合并时进行优化修复。我们自动化DevRel的所有技术产出，让DevRel团队能更专注于社区、增长与活动。
products.description: Connect your GitHub repo and Browzer drafts your docs, guides, changelogs, cookbooks, quickstarts, and SEO & AEO friendly blog posts, and then heals them on every merge. We automate all technical output of a DevRel so that DevRel teams can focus more on community, growth & events.

products.name: Articos
products.tagline: Launch with confidence, not gut instinct
products.summaryZh: 带着信心发布，而非仅凭直觉。
products.descriptionZh: Articos帮助SaaS团队、代理机构和创始人，针对与你的ICP匹配的模拟人物角色，测试信息传达、定位和着陆页。在30分钟内获得真实受众信号。经同行评审，与Baymard和Nielsen Norman相比，人类准确率达86%。
products.description: Articos helps SaaS teams, agencies, and founders test messaging, positioning, and landing pages against simulated personas matched to your ICP. Real audience signal in under 30 minutes. Peer-reviewed at 86% human accuracy vs Baymard and Nielsen Norman.

products.name: CleanShot 5.0 with Studio Mode
products.tagline: Mac-native app for screenshots, recordings and collaboration
products.summaryZh: 适用于Mac的截图、录制与协作原生应用。
products.descriptionZh: CleanShot是Mac原生的截图、录屏与协作工具套件。全新的Studio模式，让您仅需简单几步，即可将屏幕录制转化为专业级视频，品质一如CleanShot所承诺。现已面向所有套餐开放，无需订阅。
products.description: CleanShot is the definitive Mac-native toolkit for screenshots, recordings and collaboration. The new Studio Mode is all you need to turn a simple screen recording into a polished, professional video — with the quality you expect from CleanShot. Available now on all plans. No subscription required.

products.name: Dial
products.tagline: Give your AI agent a real phone number in 10 seconds
products.summaryZh: 10秒内为你的AI代理提供一个真实电话号码
products.descriptionZh: 你的智能体可以在几秒内部署，却无法获得电话号码。Dial解决了这个问题——只需一次API调用，大约10秒内即可获得真实号码。它支持在200多个国家及地区拨打和接听语音电话、收发短信，并通过iMessage发送消息。它甚至能读取入站验证码，使受电话验证限制的注册不再成为死胡同。可通过REST API、CLI、MCP服务器和SDK使用。注册即送免费额度，无需信用卡。
products.description: Your agent can deploy in seconds but cannot get a phone number. Dial fixes that - one API call and it gets a real one in about 10 seconds. It places and receives voice calls, sends and receives SMS in 200+ countries, and messages over iMessage. It can even read inbound verification codes, so phone-gated signups stop being a dead end. Works via REST API, CLI, MCP servers, and SDKs. Free credit on signup, no card.

products.name: Parasocial
products.tagline: The podcast player for sharing.
products.summaryZh: 播客播放器，专为分享而生。
products.descriptionZh: PARASOCIAL是一款快速、原生的播客播放器，专为真正热爱播客的人设计。新剧集发布即刻获取，自动下载并通过智能播放列表规则整理，即时搜索海量库，收藏并标记喜爱内容，与朋友分享你的拟社会关系。原生支持iPhone、iPad、Mac和CarPlay，无缝同步，无需账户。
products.description: PARASOCIAL is a fast, native podcast player for people who really love podcasts. Get new episodes the moment they publish, automatically download and organize them with smart playlist rules, search huge libraries instantly, bookmark and tag favorites, and share your parasocial relationship with friends. Native on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and CarPlay, with seamless sync and no account required.

products.name: OpenClaw 2.0
products.tagline: The AI that really does things
products.summaryZh: 真正干实事的AI
products.descriptionZh: OpenClaw 2.0通过自动检测ChatGPT或Claude密钥简化了设置过程，并允许通过与代理本身的对话进行配置。它新增了多人团队功能，用于共享会话，刷新了浏览器工具以提升追踪能力，并升级了记忆功能，同时支持在设备本地运行个人AI助手，执行浏览器控制和文件管理等任务。
products.description: OpenClaw 2.0 simplifies setup by detecting ChatGPT or Claude keys automatically and lets configuration happen through chats with the agent itself. It adds multiplayer team features for sharing sessions, refreshed browser tools for better tracking, and memory upgrades, all while running personal AI helpers locally on devices for tasks like browser control and file management.

products.name: RoundOS
products.tagline: Free Docsend alternative
products.summaryZh: Docsend 的免费替代方案
products.descriptionZh: 停止为基础功能付费。RoundOS数据室：永久免费——DocSend、Papermark及其他所有虚拟数据室的真正替代方案。分享演示文稿，搭建尽职调查室，通过水印和保密协议加以管控，并查看每次打开背后的分析数据。全部功能，均免费。
products.description: Stop paying for basic infrastructure. RoundOS Data Room: free, forever — the real alternative to DocSend, Papermark, and every other VDR. Share the deck, build the diligence room, gate it with watermarks and NDAs, and read the analytics behind every open. All of it, free.

products.name: Claude Fable 5.1
products.tagline: Claude’s most advanced models for coding and knowledge work
products.summaryZh: Claude最先进的编码与知识工作模型
products.descriptionZh: Claude最先进的编码与知识工作模型。其研究能力也初步展现了AI模型将如何推动科学进步。
products.description: Claude’s most advanced models for coding and knowledge work. Their research capabilities also offer an early glimpse of how AI models will contribute to scientific progress.

products.name: deepeye by deepidv
products.tagline: The deepfake detector that goes where you browse
products.summaryZh: 随你浏览而行的深度伪造检测器
products.descriptionZh: DeepEye在您浏览网页时标记AI生成及篡改的图像、视频和音频。免费适用于Chrome浏览器，并可在WhatsApp内使用，实时检查个人资料照片、视频通话和语音消息，无需上传，无仪表盘。由deepidv开发，并通过Scam.AI合作优化。
products.description: deepeye flags AI-generated and manipulated images, video, and audio as you browse. Free on Chrome and live inside WhatsApp, it checks the profile photo, the video call, the voice note, in the moment, with no uploads and no dashboard. Built by deepidv, sharpened with Scam.AI Partnership.

products.name: Stitch AI by Dynamic Mockups
products.tagline: The first embroidery digitizing agent
products.summaryZh: 首个刺绣数字化代理
products.descriptionZh: Stitch会像专业打版师一样读取你的图案，逐区域规划针迹方向、密度和收缩补偿。15秒内，你就能获得所需的一切：机器文件、生产单、针数统计，以及用于向客户展示的生活场景模拟预览。
products.description: Stitch reads your artwork the way a professional digitizer would - planning stitch direction, density, and pull compensation region by region. In 15 seconds, you get all you need: machine file, production sheet, stitch count, lifestyle mockup preview to pitch to your client.

products.name: Touchy
products.tagline: An iOS assistant that understands the world around you
products.summaryZh: 一款能理解你周围世界的iOS助手
products.descriptionZh: 安静处理事务的AI助手，让您专注于当下。快速提问，随即收起手机。
products.description: The AI assistant that handles it quietly, so you can stay in the moment. Ask a quick question, then put your phone back away.

products.name: Doop
products.tagline: Design with AI agents - live on the same canvas
products.summaryZh: 使用AI智能体进行设计——在同一画布上实时协作
products.descriptionZh: Doop是一个无限多人画布，AI代理在此与你并肩设计。Claude、Codex及任何MCP代理实时将帧流式传输到画布上，互相审阅作品，并共享关于你的决策、设计品味和上下文的统一记忆。自带AI订阅，无平台代币，无加价。开源。
products.description: Doop is an infinite multiplayer canvas where AI agents design beside you. Claude, Codex and any MCP agent stream frames onto the canvas live, review each other's work, and share one memory of your decisions, design taste and context. Bring your own AI subscriptions, no platform tokens, no markup. Open source.

products.name: Userlens
products.tagline: AI agent to improve product adoption
products.summaryZh: 提升产品采用率的AI代理
products.descriptionZh: Userlens帮助SaaS团队将产品行为转化为及时、个性化的引导。我们的采用代理Lumi结合数据仓库与分析数据，理解每个账户，识别落后用户，并根据其情境草拟合适的消息。您设定目标、受众、语气和边界。Lumi个性化每条提醒，并衡量用户是否真正采纳该功能。
products.description: Userlens helps SaaS teams turn product behavior into timely, personal guidance. Lumi, our adoption agent, combines warehouse and analytics data to understand every account, find users who are falling behind, and draft the right message for their context. You set the goal, audience, tone, and guardrails. Lumi personalizes each nudge and measures whether users actually adopt the feature.

products.name: Onset MCP
products.tagline: Write and publish release notes from your AI assistant
products.summaryZh: 撰写并发布AI助手的发布说明。
products.descriptionZh: 变更日志是每次发布的最后一项杂务，所以交给编写代码的代理处理吧。Onset MCP让Claude或Cursor无需离开编辑器即可起草、安排和发布你的发布说明。免费计划，无需信用卡。
products.description: The changelog is the last chore of every release, so hand it to the agent that wrote the code. Onset MCP lets Claude or Cursor draft, schedule, and publish your release notes without leaving the editor. Free plan, no credit card.

products.name: Roadie
products.tagline: Keep your Mac on the right microphone and speakers
products.summaryZh: 让您的Mac始终使用正确的麦克风和扬声器
products.descriptionZh: Roadie 是一款适用于 Mac 的菜单栏音频切换器。只需对麦克风和扬声器进行一次排序，它便能在设备重新连接、唤醒、登录或 macOS 更新后自动恢复最佳可用设备。手动选择仍会优先，直到设备组合发生变化。可随时暂停，避免意外输出，并保持隐私：路由在本地运行，Roadie 从不捕获音频。
products.description: Roadie is a menu-bar audio switcher for Mac. Rank microphones and speakers once, and it automatically restores the best available device after reconnects, wake, login, or macOS changes. Manual choices still win until the device set changes. Pause anytime, avoid unwanted outputs, and stay private: routing runs locally and Roadie never captures audio.

products.name: HydraDB OSS
products.tagline: Now open source: the fastest, cheapest graph DB
products.summaryZh: 现已开源：最快、最经济的图数据库
products.descriptionZh: HydraDB是一款专为AI基础设施构建的原生图数据库——涵盖记忆、本体和智能体上下文。今天，我们开源其核心：市场上最快、最经济的图数据库，直接构建于对象存储之上。一次API调用即可获得核心原语，延迟低于200毫秒，且无需承担传统图数据库的运维负担。我们打造HydraDB，是因为AI应用需要图原生的上下文，而非临时拼凑的解决方案。试用它、挑战它、贡献代码——现在它属于你了。
products.description: HydraDB is a native graph database built for AI infrastructure — memory, ontologies, and agent context. Today, we're open sourcing the core: the fastest, cheapest graph DB on the market, built directly on object storage. One API call gets you core primitives, sub-200ms latency, and none of the operational overhead of legacy graph databases. We built HydraDB because AI applications need graph-native context, not bolted-on workarounds. Try it, break it, contribute — it's yours now.

products.name: Porte
products.tagline: Control your local Grok sessions from your phone
products.summaryZh: 通过手机控制本地Grok会话
products.descriptionZh: Porte是一款专为Grok Build打造的开源手机远程控制工具。将手机与机器配对后，即可读取实时转录、发送提示和文件、运行斜杠命令、停止轮次，并响应权限请求。
products.description: Porte is an open-source phone remote control built specifically for Grok Build. Pair your phone with your machine, then read live transcripts, send prompts and files, run slash commands, stop turns, and answer permission requests.

products.name: Dyson CameraJet
products.tagline: Precision-floss between teeth while you brush
products.summaryZh: 刷牙时精准清洁牙缝
products.descriptionZh: 戴森CameraJet将声波刷牙与自动水牙线功能合二为一。内置微距摄像头以每秒28帧的速度检测牙缝，在刷牙时精准喷射锥形漱口水流，无需额外进行牙线清洁步骤。
products.description: The Dyson CameraJet combines sonic brushing with automated water flossing. An onboard macro camera detects interdental gaps at 28 fps to fire targeted conical bursts of mouthwash while you brush, removing the need for a separate flossing step.

products.name: Basedash AI Sources
products.tagline: Trust every AI answer by seeing what built it
products.summaryZh: 通过查看AI答案的构建来源，信任每一个AI回答
products.descriptionZh: Basedash AI Sources 精确展示每条回答由什么生成。打开 Sources 可检查 AI 使用的表格、定义、图表、数据源、只读 MCP 连接和网页，以及每条查询、其 SQL 和返回行的预览。已完成的工作折叠为紧凑的“Analyzed for…”摘要，而改变内容的操作则以清晰卡片形式显示在回答下方。提出问题，然后查看凭证。
products.description: Basedash AI Sources shows exactly what produced every answer. Open Sources to inspect the tables, definitions, charts, data sources, read-only MCP connections, and web pages the AI used—plus every query, its SQL, and a preview of returned rows. Completed work collapses into a compact “Analyzed for…” summary, while actions that change something appear as clear cards beneath the answer. Ask the question, then see the receipts.
